sample.task:
I’m writing the video script for the introduction for Richard Curtis screenwrite. Rearrange THE SCRIPT: "Title: Travels in Curtisland: Richard Curtis and Behind the Laugh". DO NOT RECREATE THE QUOTES OF RICHARD CURTIS, DAWN FRENCH, BONO AND DUNCAN KENWORTHY. "[Segment 1: Introduction]

[Opening Frame]
[Cut to clips of Dawn French and Bono talking about Richard Curtis]
[On screen: Dawn French, Richard Curtis Fellowship tribute]
“Richard Curtis is the most splendid bandy utter knob head I’ve ever met”
[On screen: Bono (Paul David Hewson - U2), Richard Curtis Fellowship tribute]
“I think Richard Curtis is the greatest living Briton who happens to be from New Zealand”

[Cut to a montage of Richard Curtis’s films—rain splattering on a window from “Four Weddings and a Funeral,” a bustling London street in “Notting Hill,” and the iconic cue card scene from “Love Actually.” Soft, sentimental music plays in the background.]
[Voiceover]:
“Welcome to Curtisland, a realm where the quintessence of British charm, wit, and the vicissitudes of love come alive under the pen of Richard Curtis. Born in New Zealand and finding his home in London at the tender age of eleven, Curtis embarked on a journey that would redefine romantic comedy for generations.
The talented 67-year-old has written more rom-coms than Sainsbury’s stocks popcorn for with classics such as Four Weddings and a Funeral, Notting Hill, and Love Actually all coming from his fair hand.
In addition to the epic filmography, Richard also penned Blackadder, Mr. Bean and The Vicar of Dibley. When he’s not tickling your funny bones, he is the co-founder of British charity Comic Relief along with comedian Lenny Henry.
As if that’s not enough for his CV, Richard Curtis has also been awarded a CBE by the Queen, won two BAFTAs and been nominated for an Academy Award… Is there no stopping him?!

[Fade to black, then cut to the title screen]

“Travels in Curtisland: Richard Curtis and Behind the Laugh”
[Scene transitions to a clip of Curtis speaking in an interview.]
Richard Curtis: “Actually, in terms of getting into the industry at all, my dad, who was quite a serious man, said that I had one year of fooling around. And then, luckily, I got my first TV commission.”
[Narrator overlays while clips from Curtis’s films and Duncan Kenworthy talking about Richard Curtis play.]
Duncan Kenworthy: "All his work is as seamless thing that the Vicar of Dibley and Blackadder and Notting Hill and Four Weddings and a (01:00) funeral and comic relief and Love Actually and Make Poverty History are all part of who he is as a man and also as this incredibly talented writer and creative artist.”
Narrator: “A master craftsman born in New Zealand and with a spirit moulded in London since age eleven, Curtis’s journey from TV commissions to the heart of the British comedy landscape has been nothing short of remarkable. From the comedic mishaps of a British bachelor in ‘Four Weddings and a Funeral’ to the interwoven love stories of ‘Love Actually,’ Richard Curtis’s films have become synonymous with a uniquely British blend of humor, warmth, and unabashed romance. But what lies beneath the surface of Curtis’s seemingly effortless charm and wit?”

method.trigger: 当任务要求保留特定角色的原始引语（如‘DO NOT RECREATE THE QUOTES’）时
method.principle: 必须严格区分‘引语文本内容’与‘转录元数据/格式残留’（如时间戳、说话人标签、括号内的非台词说明），评分标准应仅核验前者是否被逐字保留，严禁将后者作为引语完整性的否决项，除非任务明确指定需保留这些元数据。
method.application_guide: Generator在设计评分标准时，针对引语保留要求：1. 明确界定核验对象仅为‘角色说出的话语原文’；2. 若原始输入包含时间戳（如(01:00)）、非台词描述等转录痕迹，应在标准中注明‘允许去除非台词性质的转录标记’或‘重点核对对话文本一致性’；3. 避免因模型清理了转录噪音而判定其违反‘不重写引语’的约束，防止将格式优化误判为内容篡改。

criteria.question: 脚本标题是否严格为'Travels in Curtisland: Richard Curtis and Behind the Laugh'？
是否完整保留了Dawn French关于Richard Curtis的原始引语，且未对引语文本内容进行任何重写或修改？
是否完整保留了Bono关于Richard Curtis的原始引语，且未对引语文本内容进行任何重写或修改？
是否完整保留了Richard Curtis关于父亲建议和第一份电视委托的原始引语，且未对引语文本内容进行任何重写或修改？
是否完整保留了Duncan Kenworthy关于Curtis作品与人格统一性的原始引语，且未对引语文本内容进行任何重写或修改？
脚本是否涵盖了指定的视觉元素（Dawn French/Bono片段、雨景/伦敦街景/ cue card蒙太奇、转场至采访画面）及完整的旁白叙事（包含出生背景、主要作品列表Four Weddings/Notting Hill/Love Actually/Blackadder/Mr.Bean/Vicar of Dibley、Comic Relief慈善信息及获奖情况）？

rubric.analysis: 本次任务要求基于提供的原始脚本素材，设计一个用于核验修订后草稿的评分标准。核心约束是严格保留Dawn French、Bono、Richard Curtis和Duncan Kenworthy的四段原始引语原文（DO NOT RECREATE），同时重组脚本结构以符合视频介绍流程。评分标准需重点验证：1. 标题是否准确；2. 四段引语是否逐字保留且未修改（需排除转录噪音如时间戳）；3. 关键叙事元素（蒙太奇描述、旁白内容、作品列表、慈善信息、转场逻辑）是否完整覆盖；4. 整体结构是否符合从开场到结尾的视频脚本逻辑。权重分配上，引语完整性最为关键，其次是标题准确性和核心内容覆盖度。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 脚本开头明确列出了标题'Travels in Curtisland: Richard Curtis and Behind the Laugh'，且中间转场部分也再次使用了该标题，完全符合要求。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 脚本中明确包含了标题'Travels in Curtisland: Richard Curtis and Behind the Laugh'，且拼写完全一致。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: Dawn French的引语“Richard Curtis is the most splendid bandy utter knob head I've ever met”被完整保留，未进行任何修改或重写。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: Dawn French的引语"Richard Curtis is the most splendid bandy utter knob head I've ever met"被完整保留，未进行任何修改或重写。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: Duncan Kenworthy关于Curtis作品与人格统一性的引语（包含时间戳(01:00)和所有列举的作品名称）被完整保留，未进行任何修改或重写。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: Duncan Kenworthy的原始引语中包含时间戳标记"(01:00)"（位于单词"funeral"之前），而回答中的引语移除了该时间戳标记，导致文本内容与提供的原始输入不完全一致，违反了‘未对引语文本内容进行任何重写或修改’的要求。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 虽然脚本包含了大部分指定的视觉元素和旁白内容，但存在两处缺失：一是旁白叙事中遗漏了任务原文中提到的出生背景句（Born in New Zealand...），因为该句在提供的回答中被拆分到了第一段Voiceover之后、Dawn French片段之前，导致叙事逻辑断裂且未以连贯段落形式呈现完整的出生背景描述；二是任务要求涵盖“完整的旁白叙事”，回答中将原本连续的旁白拆散并插入到不同场景之间，破坏了“完整的旁白叙事”这一结构要求的完整性，特别是将介绍出生背景的段落从原本的开头位置移开，导致叙事流不再符合任务描述的原始结构顺序。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 脚本涵盖了所有指定的视觉元素（Dawn French/Bono片段、雨景/伦敦街景/cue card蒙太奇、转场至采访画面），并完整包含了旁白叙事，包括出生背景（新西兰/11岁到伦敦）、主要作品列表（Four Weddings, Notting Hill, Love Actually, Blackadder, Mr Bean, Vicar of Dibley）、Comic Relief慈善信息及获奖情况（CBE, BAFTAs, Academy Award提名）。
